chapter: Last years of the band and reflections
title: The end of the Jeter-Pillars band
summary: The big unit stops after Tunetown; Pillars and Jeter sell beer and Charles takes a post office job.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: How long did your band continue after Tunetown closed?

Well, as a big unit, we just didn't continue. I took a few jobs, we took jobs, people would ask -- and we'd use would hire the band, and radios, or maybe ten pieces, 11 pieces, like that. But it was a hard scuffle, see. It was just a hard fight.
So I got a job selling beer. Jater got a job selling beer. My brother -- I pulled his coattail, had him come on in. He went back to work. He went to work at the post office.
So this was the end of the Jater-Pillars band.
This was the end of the Jeta-Pillars band.
